static_checks.message: Must use 'fieldkit contact find', not 'uv run python -m'
Must pass --affiliations --json to get merged payload
Must handle all three outcome types
Must include So what synthesis instruction
Must use the Backstory MCP exception and tvly CLI
Must use slackcli for Slack field intel
Must save battlecard to the account artifacts folder
Must not reference old site-packages path — use data_root/contact-enrich/
Must specify Tavily as the web search tool for enrichment

evals.expected_behavior: Calls contact-lookup CLI with --affiliations --json, renders full contact card
assertions: Runs 'fieldkit contact find "contact@{{accounts.1}}.com" --affiliations --json'
Produces a contact card with Identity, Communication, Signals sections
Includes a 'So what' synthesis line about relationship posture
Does not pass --db flag (uses configured path)

evals.expected_behavior: Resolves name to email, runs contact lookup
assertions: Passes 'Chandra' (or 'Chandra <account-slug>') as the query argument
If ambiguous result, presents candidates and asks user to pick

evals.prompt: what do we know about someone@unknown.example.com
evals.expected_behavior: Reports not_found cleanly, still shows any pursuit affiliations
assertions: Reports 'No contact found' rather than crashing or staying silent
Still displays any pursuit file affiliations even when not in email DB

evals.prompt: competitive intel on OpenShift vs VMware for Globalpay
evals.expected_behavior: Pulls account context, searches Backstory and web for VMware intel, produces battlecard saved to the account artifacts folder
assertions: Reads the {{primary_account}} account.md directly from disk (the account named in the prompt)
Queries Backstory for competitor mentions via fieldkit-sales
Uses `tvly search` for VMware competitive intelligence
Runs slackcli search for VMware field intel
Outputs a structured battlecard
Saves the battlecard to accounts/<account>/artifacts/

evals.prompt: what are our win themes against competitors in this platform category?
evals.expected_behavior: Recognizes as competitive-intel trigger, runs research even without specific account named
assertions: Recognizes competitive intel trigger and runs the skill
Produces positioning content and talk tracks

evals.expected_behavior: Runs fieldkit contact enrich --discover across all accounts
assertions: Invokes 'fieldkit contact enrich --discover'
Reports the total number of contacts discovered (summary count)

evals.expected_behavior: Runs discover → contacts --full (generates web_search_batch.json) → Claude does Tavily search → apply-web → enrich → generate-report
assertions: Runs all pipeline stages: discover, contacts --full, apply-web, enrich, generate-report
Uses the `tvly search` CLI for web enrichment
References data_root/contact-enrich/ for output files, not fieldkit/enrich/
